gaps.hint: person needed: someone who installs wiring
gaps.explanation: An electrician is the person who works with electricity; 'electric' and 'electrical' are adjectives.

gaps.sentence: The government's ___ (DECIDE) to raise taxes was criticized.
gaps.explanation: After 'The government's' a noun is needed: decision (-sion noun); 'decisive' is an adjective.

gaps.sentence: Heavy snow made the mountain road ___ (PASS).
gaps.hint: negative adjective needed: impossible to travel through (im- + -able)
gaps.explanation: Heavy snow blocks the road, so the negative adjective 'impassable' (im- + pass + -able) is needed.

gaps.sentence: The instructions were unclear, so I had to ___ them completely (WRITE).
gaps.hint: write again — unclear the first time (re-); base verb needed
gaps.explanation: The prefix re- means again: rewrite. A base verb is needed after 'had to'.

gaps.sentence: She gave a very ___ account of the incident that had everyone laughing (HUMOUR).
gaps.explanation: Everyone laughed, so the adjective is humorous (-ous). 'Humourless' means serious and would contradict the laughter.

gaps.sentence: The ___ between rich and poor is widening (DIVIDE).
gaps.explanation: The subject must be a noun: division (-sion). 'Divisive' is an adjective.

gaps.sentence: He denied all knowledge of the ___ (APPEAR) of the documents.
gaps.explanation: The documents vanished, so the negative noun 'disappearance' is needed; 'appearance' means coming into view.

gaps.sentence: The ___ of the new bridge will take two years (CONSTRUCT).
gaps.hint: noun needed as subject of the sentence
gaps.explanation: The subject needs a noun: construction (the -tion noun); 'constructive' is an adjective.
